title: Fluorescent 2 color Whole mount _in situ_ hybridization for a mouse embryo
protocol: Digest the plasmids with restriction enzyme which generates a 5’ protruding terminus.
Check 1μl of reacted DNA in a gel and confirm complete digestion.
Add 4μl of 5mg/ml ProK and 10μl of 10% SDS, then incubate for 30 min at 37°C.
Add 2M Tris pH7.5 6μl and phenol-chloroform 100μl, vortex and centrifuge for 5 min at room temperature with 15,000 rpm.
Recover the supernatant to a new 1.5ml tube and repeat step 4.
Recover the supernatant to a new tube and add 100μl chloroform. Vortex and centrifuge for 5 min at room temperature with 15,000 rpm.
Recover the supernatant to a new tube and add 300μl ethanol and 3M sodium acetate.
Mix by inverting the tube and centrifuge for 10 min at 4°C with 15000rpm.
Discard the supernatant and wash the pellet with 80% ethanol.
Discard the supernatant, dry the pellet, dissolve it in 15μl Tris-EDTA, and store at -20°C.
For Dig labeled RNA probes:
Mix DNA template (2μl), 5x buffer (4μl), DIG solution (2μl), H₂O (10μl), RNase inhibitor (1μl), T3 or T7 polymerase diluted in RNA dilution buffer (1μl) and incubate at 37°C for 3 hours.
Check the synthesized quantity by running a gel 1 hour after the reaction.
If the quantity is small, add more enzyme to the reaction tube.
Add 0.5M EDTA (8.0) and 8M LiCl solutions each in 1 μl to the reaction tube after 3 hours of reaction.
Add EtOH in 75 μl to the reaction tube.
Mix well and immediately centrifuge at 15,000 rpm for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Wash with 80% EtOH.
Dry the pellet and dissolve it in 20 μl TE buffer.
Add 8M LiCl (1 μl) to the solution.
Add EtOH (75 μl) to the solution.
Mix well and immediately centrifuge at 15,000 rpm for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Wash with 80% EtOH.
Dry the pellet and dissolve it in 20 μl DPEC H₂O.
Store the final product at -80°C.
For synthesis of antisense RNA probe:
Mix Template DNA (6 μl), buffer (12 μl), ATP (6 μl), CTP (6 μl), GTP (6 μl), UTP (6 μl), H₂O (12 μl), Rnase Inhibitor (3 μl) and T7 or T3 enzyme (3 μl).
Incubate the mixture at 37°C for 3 hours.
Add DNase I (6 μl, 10 u/μl) to the reaction tube and incubate for 15 minutes at 37°C.
Purify RNA probes using a Roche G50 column.
Mix purified RNA with 3 volumes of EtOH and 3M Sodium Acetate and mix well.
Centrifuge at 4°C, 15,000 rpm for 10 minutes.
Discard supernatant and wash pellet by 80% EtOH.
Repeat steps involving centrifugation and washing with 80% EtOH.
Dry the pellet and dissolve it in 20 μl H₂O.
Mix RNA probes with DNP labeling kit solutions according to instructions and incubate at 37°C for 2 hours.
Purify RNA probe by a column.
Add 3 volumes of EtOH and 3M Sodium Acetate to the mixture.
Centrifuge at 4°C, 15000 rpm for 10 minutes.
Discard supernatant and wash pellet with 80% EtOH.
Dry the pellet and dissolve in 5 μl H2O.
Dissect embryos out in DEPC-PBS and fix in 4% PFA.
Rock at 4°C for 5 hours to overnight.
Wash embryos with 25%, 50%, 75% MeOH in PBT, then twice with 100% MeOH.
Rehydrate through the methanol/PBT series in reverse and wash twice with PBT.
Bleach embryos with 6% hydrogen peroxidase in PBT for 1 hour.
Wash embryos three times with PBT for 5 minutes each.
Treat embryos with 10 μg/ml Proteinase K in PBT for 15 minutes.
Refix the embryos with 0.2% glutaraldehyde/4% PFA.
Wash the embryos three times with PBT.
Soak embryos in 0.25% NH3/70% EtOH for 20 minutes.
PBT wash embryos three times.
Soak embryos in freshly prepared 0.1% Sodium Borohydride/PBT solution for 30 minutes and repeat this step four times.
Wash embryos three times with PBT.
Change to PreHybridization Mix solution two times.
PreHybridize at 70°C for 30 minutes in a Hybridization oven.
Change solution to Hybridization Mix (probeA, DIG; probeB, DNP/Prehybridization Mix).
Incubate overnight at 70°C.
Wash the embryos twice with solution I for 30 minutes at 72°C.
Wash the embryos twice with solution III for 30 minutes at 72°C.
Wash the embryos three times with solution II for 5 minutes each.
Wash the embryos with 100 μg/ml RNaseA in solution II for 30 minutes at 37°C.
Wash the embryos for 5 minutes with solution II, then with solution III.
Wash the embryos twice with solution III for 30 minutes at 67°C.
TBST wash the embryos three times.
Change to blocking solution and incubate at 4°C with rocking for 1 hour.
Incubate in blocking solution containing anti-DIG-HRP (Roche) at 4°C overnight with rocking.
Wash the embryos three times for 5 minutes with TBST on day 5.
TBST wash the embryos for 1 hour at 4°C with rocking, repeating five times.
Change to amplification buffer and wait a few minutes.
Incubate in amplification buffer containing Tyramide-Alexa555 (Molecular Probe TSA kit) at 4°C for 30 minutes in the dark room.
Make 30% H₂O₂ in amplification buffer (solution A).
Prepare solution B by mixing Tyramide-Alexa555, solution A, and amplification buffer.
Incubate with solution B at room temperature in a dark room for 30 minutes.
TBST wash the embryos three times for 5 minutes each.
Change to H₂O including 0.1M Glysin, pH2.5 (adjust pH by adding 30% HCl).
Incubate for 30 min at room temperature.
TBST wash 3 times for 5 min each.
Change to blocking solution and incubate at 4°C for 1 hour with rocking.
Add Anti-DNP-HRP (PerkinElmer) 1 μl to the blocking solution and incubate overnight at 4°C with rocking.
